entries.note: A job row in archived captures of the tracker: the consignment left the office named first for the next one. The adapter words it "Out To …", as the status line does.
A job row in archived captures of the tracker: the office named first received the consignment from the other. The adapter words it "Received At …", as the status line does.
The status line after an OUT job, with the next office and the day.
The status line after an IN job, with the office and the day.
The status line of a delivered consignment, with the day and the delivering office. The page then hides its jobs.
Seen as the status of an archived lookup on the older tracker.
The older tracker's misspelt status, seen in archived lookups.
